svg.text: Figure 2. External REST Integration, Caching, and 3-Layer AI Guardrail Pipeline
Server-side orchestration across Open Library, Open-Meteo, and Google Gemini with deterministic fallbacks and RA 10173 data minimization
LANE A · OPEN LIBRARY REST API & FAMILY BOOKSHELF
Zero GPS history persisted in Firestore.
Fetches WMO weather code, precipitation & temperature
Classifies indoor vs. outdoor play conditions.
Displays calm indoor or outdoor hint on /today.
CTA opens AI Idea Helper with setting preselected
LANE C · GOOGLE GEMINI REST API & 3-LAYER PEDIATRIC GUARDRAILS
Tier 3 Deterministic Fallback (fallback.ts) — Guaranteed Safe Response
Triggered automatically on: missing API key, 8s timeout, upstream 429/5xx, open circuit breaker, all materials unsafe, or Layer 3 validation rejection.
Returns reviewed Firestore catalog_activities filtered by ageBand/setting/domain with source: 'fallback' ('Our picks' badge). (/ai/adapt uses Tier 2 rule-based fallback.)
Privacy Boundary (RA 10173): Child nicknames, birth months, exact locations, and private journal entries are stripped by schema and never leave the authenticated account.
